mapper.select: SELECT detail_code_id, group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_detail_code_id, display_order, additional_attributes::text AS additional_attributes, use_status FROM detail_code WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY display_order, code_value

SELECT detail_code_id, group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_detail_code_id, display_order, additional_attributes::text AS additional_attributes, use_status FROM detail_code WHERE detail_code_id = #{detailCodeId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT detail_code_id, group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_detail_code_id, display_order, additional_attributes::text AS additional_attributes, use_status FROM detail_code WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND code_value = #{codeValue} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM code_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO detail_code (detail_code_id, group_id, code_value, code_name, parent_detail_code_id, display_order, additional_attributes, use_status) VALUES (#{detailCodeId}, #{groupId}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{parentDetailCodeId}, #{displayOrder}, CAST(#{additionalAttributes} AS jsonb), 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE detail_code SET group_id = #{groupId}, code_value = #{codeValue}, code_name = #{codeName}, parent_detail_code_id = #{parentDetailCodeId}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, additional_attributes = CAST(#{additionalAttributes} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE detail_code_id = #{detailCodeId} AND use_status = 'ACTIVE'
